headline: Three Oil Tankers Attacked Near Strait of Hormuz Amid Regional Tensions
summary: At least three commercial oil tankers were attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz, threatening maritime traffic in the vital energy shipping corridor.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most vital oil transit bottleneck, through which approximately one-fifth of global petroleum supplies pass daily.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Attacks on tankers near the Strait of Hormuz threaten global crude oil shipments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Security disruptions to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz raise risk premiums across global oil markets.
